Resolves #19213

The provisional vessel chrome's replacement branch now retires through the same guard as every other retirement: a chrome that lost its viewport hands the pane it still holds over detached and is destroyed only then, so the "never destroyed with its pane" invariant lives in one place. The class-shape optional chains are gone; the one remaining `?.` guards a real `null`. This is Ada's optional notes 1 and 3 on PR #19212, which reached that branch three minutes after its merge.

Evidence: L1 (unit, red first) → L1 required (AC-1, AC-2). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: mechanical — a guard consolidation and a lint-level cleanup with a unit arm, no behaviour change on the stage, mount or retirement paths.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the CI baseline jobs ran.
